texts.preamble: State vs Sanjeev Kumar Roy on 19 December, 2025 In The Court Of Ms. Pranjali Prakash, Judicial Magistrate First Class (Digital Traffic Court) North-East District, Karkardooma Court Complex, Delhi Tc No.: 1156/2024 Cnr No. Dlne020041992024 State Versus Sanjeev Kumar Roy 1 . Name & address of the accused : Sanjeev Kumar Roy, S/o Ram Kripal Roy, R/o RZH-697A, Gali No. 15, Raj Nagar Part-II, Palam Colony, New Delhi-110077. 2.
texts.facts: It has been alleged by the Prosecution that on 20.04.2024 at about 12:09 pm, at Khajuri Chowk, Delhi falling within the jurisdiction of Khajuri Traffic Circle, motorcycle of the accused was found with a defective front plate and was also found to be using pressure horn and therefore was challaned for committing the offence under Section 39 r/w section 192 of M.V. Act, 1988. 3. It is pertinent to mention here that the cognizance of the offence had already been taken by Virtual Traffic Court and a fine was proposed for the summary disposal of the case under Section 208, M.V. Act. The accused exercised the option to contest the present challan on the web portal of Virtual Traffic Court, pursuant to which the present challan was transferred to this Court for adjudication as per law. Proceedings before the Court: 4. Accused Sanjeev Kumar Roy, entered his first appearance before this Court on 29.07.2024. Notice under Section 274 BNSS was framed against him on 09.10.2025 to which he pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. The accused pleaded that he lives in PRANJALI PRANJALI PRAKASH PRAKASH Date: 2025.12.19 TC No. 1156/2024 State vs. Sanjeev Kumar Roy 15:52:36 -0300 Palam and he never went to Khajuri Chowk. The phone number mentioned on the challan does not belong to him. He further pleaded that he contacted the concerned traffic officials, who called on the number on the challan and it was found that the number belongs to someone residing in Ghaziabad, U.P. It was thus pleaded by him that he has not committed any offence in violation of the provisions of the M.V. Act and the present challan has been wrongly issued against him by the Traffic Police. 5. In order to prove its case, the Prosecution wished to examine two witnesses PW-1 ASI Brijpal and PW-2 HC Sunil. PW-1 in his examination-in-chief brought on record the original challan exhibited PW1/A and deposed that on 20.04.2024, he was posted at Khajuri Traffic Circle at Khajuri Chowk as a ASI and on that day, at around 12:09 pm, a person was seen driving the motorcycle bearing number DL-6SBC-3514 without wearing helmet and using pressure horn. He further deposed that he challaned the said motorcycle and took the signatures of the driver on the said challan at point B and also took the photographs but the same cannot be produced as the same are destroyed by the authority concerned within six months. 6. In his cross-examination, PW1, deposed that on that day, accused Sanjeev Kumar Roy was not present at the spot and he was not driving the said motorcycle. He further deposed that he could not produce the notification regarding the destruction of photographs of authority concerned. PRANJALI PRANJALI PRAKASH PRAKASH Date: 2025.12.19 15:52:44 -0300 7. PW-2 in his examination-in-chief corroborated the testimony of PW1. 8. After completion of Prosecution Evidence, the statement of accused was recorded on 01.12.2025 under section 351 BNSS wherein the entire incriminating evidence appearing against the accused State vs Sanjeev Kumar Roy on 19 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141721249/ 2 was put to him to which he stated that his vehicle has been wrongly challaned. 9. Thereafter, the matter was listed for Defence Evidence. Accused examined himself as DW-1 and in his examination-in- chief, it was deposed by him that he has a pulser bike bearing number DL6SBC3514 and his bike does not have a pressure horn neither does it have a defective front plate.
texts.arguments: In the present case, a violation of section 39 of M.V. Act has been alleged which reads as:- Necessity of Registration:- "No person shall drive any motor vehicle and no owner of a motor vehicle shall cause or permit the vehicle to be driven in any public place or in any other place unless the vehicle is registered in accordance with this Chapter and the certificate of PRANJALI by PRANJALI PRAKASH TC No. 1156/2024 State vs. Sanjeev Kumar Roy PRAKASH Date: 2025.12.19 15:52:52 -0300 registration of the vehicle has not been suspended or cancelled and the vehicle carries a registration mark displayed in the prescribed manner: PROVIDED that nothing in this section shall apply to motor vehicle in possession of a dealer subject to such conditions as may be prescribed by the Central Government". 12. In the present case, a violation of section 192 of M.V. Act has been alleged which reads as:- Using vehicles without registration:- "(1) Whoever drives a motor vehicle or cause or allows a motor vehicle to be used contravention of the provisions of section 39 shall be punishable for the first offence with a fine which may extend to five thousand rupees but shall not be less than two thousand rupees for a second or subsequent offence with imprisonment which may extend to one year or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees but shall not be less than five thousand rupees or with both: PROVIDED that the court may, for reasons to be recorded, impose a lesser punishment. (2) Nothing in this section shall apply to the use of a motor vehicle in an emergency for the conveyance of persons suffering from sickness or injuries or for the transport of food or materials to relieve distress or of medical supplies for a like purpose: (3) The court to which an appeal lies from any conviction in respect of an offence of the nature specified in sub-section (1), may [LEAKAGE_MASK] or vary any PRANJALI by 3[Explanation: Use of a motor vehicle in contravention of the provisions of section 56 shall be deemed to be a contravention of the provisions of section 39 and shall be punishable in the same manner as provided in sub-section (1).]" 14. Section 39 of the Motor Vehicles Act casts a prohibition on the driving of any vehicle by a person unless the same is registered.
